privacy_rules: Do not commit personal email addresses, phone numbers, private CRM notes, API keys, or customer secrets.
Use evidence URLs, public listing URLs, task IDs, and aggregate outcomes instead of personal contact details.
Record actual revenue only after Stripe, invoice, or signed-contract evidence exists.

revenue.pilot_checkout_launch.notes: Stripe checkout sync from 2026-06-25 is not authoritative for TinyZKP revenue because the local Stripe CLI profile was later found to report display_name='Galen Health', not TinyZKP. Keep actual_revenue_cents at 0 until Stripe payment, invoice, or signed-contract evidence is verified from the TinyZKP account. Rerun billing/stripe_account_context_check.py, billing/stripe_checkout_monitor.py, and scripts/marketing/sync_stripe_checkout_pipeline.py after the local CLI is switched to TinyZKP. No buyer PII, Stripe object IDs, or checkout URLs are stored here.

revenue.stripe_catalog_hygiene.notes: Attempted live catalog diagnosis with the authenticated local Stripe CLI, then discovered the active profile reports display_name='Galen Health', not TinyZKP. Treat prior Stripe catalog reads as non-authoritative for TinyZKP. The setup scripts and write preflight now validate account context before reads or writes; switch the CLI to the TinyZKP account, rerun billing/stripe_account_context_check.py, then rerun setup with a write-capable profile. No Stripe object IDs, account IDs, request URLs, or key material are stored here.

mcp_submission.official_mcp_registry.notes: Published TinyZKP to the official MCP Registry as io.github.logannye/tinyzkp with the hosted streamable HTTP endpoint.

mcp_submission.mcp_so.notes: Submitted TinyZKP through MCP.so GitHub issue #2916 after the site form required sign-in. GitHub issue remained open on 2026-06-25 and MCP.so search pages only echoed the TinyZKP query, with no accepted listing link found.

mcp_submission.glama.notes: TinyZKP is live in the official MCP Registry, which Glama describes as an upstream source. Strict Glama query check on 2026-06-25 returned an empty MCP server result list for TinyZKP; Add Server redirects to sign-up.

mcp_submission.mcpservers_org.notes: Programmatic free submission accepted as pending submission id 3934. Strict mcpservers.org TinyZKP query on 2026-06-25 did not find a public accepted listing yet.

mcp_submission.pulsemcp.notes: TinyZKP is live in the official MCP Registry; PulseMCP public submit/search pages blocked headless submission. Strict PulseMCP search on 2026-06-25 only returned search pagination links, not a TinyZKP listing, so monitor downstream registry ingestion.

mcp_submission.cursor_directory.notes: Cursor Directory now uses cursor.directory and the Open Plugins standard. Package is ready in plugins/tinyzkp-cursor; submit via GitHub autodetect or manual form, then update listing_url when accepted.

mcp_submission.awesome_mcp_servers.notes: Submitted TinyZKP to the upstream awesome-mcp-servers Security section via PR #8733. PR remained open and mergeable on 2026-06-25.
